purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The Shangqiu Real Estate Registration and Transaction Center publishes city-local land-registration, cadastral-map, and parcel-map query pages. The cadastral-map page links to a separate public map viewer; parcel-map query uses a real-property unit/address plus applicant, purpose, and captcha. The map viewer shell did not return an HTTP response in this environment, and no full polygon schema or response was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Shangqiu Real Estate Registration and Transaction Center parcel-map query page; fields require property unit/address, applicant, purpose and captcha. No property-specific query was submitted.
Official center cadastral-map page offers cadastral district/subdistrict type and a purpose field; the query link leads to a separate viewer at http://222.138.172.5:8222/.
Official city center organization page lists the local registry institution and service center.
Official city center page describes its real-estate registration/transaction surveying service center.
